originalGroup.material:
Piano Recital Page Turn 024

For the school recital, Finn turned pages for his friend Rosa at the piano. In rehearsal, he always turned after the same line. During the performance, Rosa repeated a short section to recover from a mistake. Finn nearly turned too soon. He stopped when he saw her finger return to the start of the line.
Instead of counting the usual seconds, he followed the notes she was actually playing. The page turn happened later than planned, but Rosa continued smoothly. After the recital, Finn said he had worried that waiting meant he was doing his job badly. Rosa thanked him for watching her rather than the clock. For the next rehearsal, they agreed on a small nod to signal a turn if the music changed unexpectedly.

At the camp, our guide planned a short firefly walk. The note asked us to use the marked path, keep voices low and leave phone flashes off. It did not promise that we would see fireflies. The next evening was calm, and the walk went ahead. We saw only a few lights. The guide asked us to record what we actually saw, not copy a large number from another group’s report.

At the camp, our guide planned a short firefly walk. The note asked us to use the marked path, keep voices low and leave phone flashes off. It did not promise that we would see fireflies. Their activity depended on weather and other conditions. On the first night, strong wind led the guide to cancel the walk before we left camp. We watched a recorded talk indoors instead. The next evening was calm, and the walk went ahead. We saw only a few lights. The guide asked us to record what we actually saw, not copy a large number from another group’s report.
questions.explanation: A正确：record actually saw非抄他组大数；B否认记录要求。
